name.evidence: MINT-1T: Scaling Open-Source Multimodal Data by 10x: A Multimodal Dataset with One Trillion Tokens

description.evidence: MINT-1T comprises of one trillion text tokens and 3.4 billion images, a 10x scale-up from existing open-source datasets. Additionally, we include previously untapped sources such as PDFs and ArXiv papers.

url.evidence: We release our data at https://github.com/mlfoundations/MINT-1T .

license.evidence: We release MINT-1T under a CC-BY-4.0 licence.

creator.evidence: The dataset is created by a team from the University of Washington, Salesforce Research, Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, and University of Califomia Berkeley.

inLanguage.evidence: Initially, we eliminate non-English documents using Fasttext’s [Joulin et al., 2017] language identification model

rai:dataCollection.evidence: The data comes from CommonCrawl dumps and is filtered using a series of rules-based heuristics and deduplication methods.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: Data was obtained from a third party web crawl, CommonCrawl, for HTML and PDF documents and directly from ArXiv S3 buckets for ArXiv documents.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: MINT-1T’s HTML documents are filtered from CommonCrawl WARC dumps from 2017 to 2024... MINT-1T PDF documents are filtered from CommonCrawl WAT dumps from 2023 to 2024... MINT-1T ArXiv documents is a subset of all ArXiv documents.

rai:dataCollectionTimeframe.evidence: The data was collected from January 2024 to June 2024. We include web data from 2013 to 2024.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: Yes, the dataset was preprocessed to remove low quality text, duplicate documents/text portions, and remove not safe for work and low quality images.

rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan.evidence: Yes the dataset will be updated by the authors of this work. We will communicate updates through the README in the Huggingface interface.

rai:personalSensitiveInformation.evidence: We masked personally identifiable information such as emails and IP addresses to remove personal data from MINT-1T.

rai:dataSocialImpact.evidence: An important consideration when releasing large datasets is to avoid exposing harmful content from the web. We were careful about filtering out personally identifiable information and not safe for work content from MINT-1T.

rai:dataBiases.evidence: We follow previous works in not using text quality classifier models as they have been shown to favor text from certain demographics.

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: We noticed two limitations with using the PyMuPDF package for parsing PDFs: 1) we sometimes are unable to detect images 2) as PDFs have arbitrary layouts, in some cases we extract an incorrect reading order

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: MINT-1T is built for pre-training large multimodal models that can process multiple interleaved images and text.
